#
#   COD_VERSION=uo COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=32681 PROBE_SECS=230 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_turret mp_carentan +set probe_teleport 1 +set probe_hitlog 1
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --game-dir <UO install> --mod-dir uo --net-probe 127.0.0.1:32681 --probe-team axis --probe-fall --probe-secs 200
